dataset_name: RBI policy repo-rate and monetary-policy decision history

decisions.row_grain: one row per canonical monetary-policy/rate observation

fields.name: decision_id
fields.description: Stable dataset-generated identifier for one canonical ledger row.

fields.name: snapshot_decision_id
fields.description: Original decision identifier from SnapshotV2.

fields.name: canonical_key
fields.description: Globally readable instrument/date key: IN:RBI:policy_repo_rate:YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction code: IN.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name: India.

fields.name: central_bank
fields.description: Central bank responsible for the instrument.

fields.name: central_bank_code
fields.description: Short central-bank code: RBI.

fields.name: decision_authority
fields.description: Authority identified by the source type, or null when not known.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

fields.name: instrument
fields.description: Human-readable policy instrument name.

fields.name: instrument_code
fields.description: Stable machine-readable instrument code.

fields.name: record_type
fields.description: policy_decision for a policy-resolution record; historical_rate_observation for imported history.

fields.name: date_semantics
fields.description: Whether the date represents a resolution/effective date or a historical observation date.

fields.name: decision_date
fields.description: Date of the identified policy decision; null for imported historical observations.
fields.null_semantics: Null means no separate policy-decision date is identified by the source record.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date on which the canonical rate observation is effective or recorded.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year derived from effective_date.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Calendar month number derived from effective_date.

fields.name: policy_rate_pct
fields.description: Policy repo rate in percent, retained as a convenient numeric view.

fields.name: policy_rate_bps
fields.description: Policy repo rate in basis points; exactly round(policy_rate_pct * 100).

fields.name: previous_policy_rate_pct
fields.description: Previous canonical policy rate in percent.
fields.null_semantics: Null for the first canonical observation.

fields.name: previous_policy_rate_bps
fields.description: Previous canonical policy rate in basis points.
fields.null_semantics: Null for the first canonical observation.

fields.name: change_bps
fields.description: Signed change from the previous canonical policy rate in basis points; zero for the initial observation.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Canonical transition label: initial, hike, cut, or hold.

fields.name: stance
fields.description: Monetary-policy stance when explicitly available.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the canonical source does not provide a structured stance.

fields.name: is_rate_change
fields.description: True when change_bps is non-zero.

fields.name: decision_summary
fields.description: Short deterministic factual summary generated from structured fields; source prose is not republished.

fields.name: regime_id
fields.description: Stable join key for the repository-provided regime interval containing effective_date.
fields.null_semantics: Null means effective_date falls in a gap between regime intervals.

fields.name: regime_type
fields.description: Repository-provided contextual regime type.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

fields.name: regime_label
fields.description: Repository-provided contextual regime label.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

fields.name: primary_source_id
fields.description: Highest-priority source attached to this decision under the deterministic source-priority policy.

fields.name: primary_source_type
fields.description: Type of primary_source_id.

fields.name: primary_source_title
fields.description: Title of primary_source_id.

fields.name: primary_source_url
fields.description: URL of primary_source_id.

fields.name: primary_source_published_at
fields.description: Publication timestamp of primary_source_id when supplied.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the source record does not provide a publication timestamp.

fields.name: primary_source_retrieved_at
fields.description: Retrieval timestamp of primary_source_id.

fields.name: primary_source_checksum
fields.description: SHA-256 checksum recorded for primary_source_id.

fields.name: source_ids
fields.description: All source identifiers attached to the canonical row, sorted deterministically.

fields.name: source_count
fields.description: Number of distinct attached source identifiers.

fields.name: provenance_class
fields.description: Strongest attached provenance class: official_primary, official_secondary, or legacy_import.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.description: Deterministic verification label exposing primary, legacy, secondary, or mixed support.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: SnapshotV2 identifier used as the build input.

fields.name: snapshot_checksum
fields.description: SnapshotV2 content checksum used as the build input.

fields.name: snapshot_retrieved_at
fields.description: SnapshotV2 retrieval timestamp.

fields.name: dataset_schema_version
fields.description: Independent semantic schema version for this dataset.

fields.name: record_text
fields.description: Deterministically generated factual sentence intended for search, RAG, and agent use.

annual.row_grain: one row per calendar year from the earliest through latest snapshot year

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year, including years with no canonical ledger records.

fields.name: start_policy_rate_pct
fields.description: Rate in force immediately before January 1 of the year.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no earlier canonical rate is available.

fields.name: end_policy_rate_pct
fields.description: Rate in force on December 31 of the year.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no canonical rate is in force by year end.

fields.name: min_policy_rate_pct
fields.description: Minimum known in-force rate during the year, including a carry-in rate.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no canonical rate is known during the year.

fields.name: max_policy_rate_pct
fields.description: Maximum known in-force rate during the year, including a carry-in rate.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no canonical rate is known during the year.

fields.name: net_change_bps
fields.description: End rate minus start rate in basis points; null if either boundary is unknown.
fields.null_semantics: Null when start_policy_rate_pct or end_policy_rate_pct is null.

fields.name: gross_hikes_bps
fields.description: Sum of positive canonical transitions within the calendar year.

fields.name: gross_cuts_bps
fields.description: Absolute sum of negative canonical transitions within the calendar year.

fields.name: decision_count
fields.description: Count of all canonical ledger rows whose effective_date falls in the year.

fields.name: policy_decision_count
fields.description: Count of policy_decision rows in the year.

fields.name: historical_observation_count
fields.description: Count of historical_rate_observation rows in the year.

fields.name: hike_count
fields.description: Count of canonical rows labeled hike in the year.

fields.name: cut_count
fields.description: Count of canonical rows labeled cut in the year.

fields.name: hold_count
fields.description: Count of canonical rows labeled hold in the year.

fields.name: first_decision_date
fields.description: Effective date of the first canonical row in the year.
fields.null_semantics: Null when the year has no canonical ledger rows.

fields.name: last_decision_date
fields.description: Effective date of the last canonical row in the year.
fields.null_semantics: Null when the year has no canonical ledger rows.

fields.name: year_end_action
fields.description: Action of the final in-year canonical row; null when the year-end rate is carried in from an earlier year.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no canonical row in the year establishes the year-end state.

fields.name: year_end_stance
fields.description: Stance of the final in-year canonical row.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no in-year stance is available.

fields.name: year_end_regime_id
fields.description: Regime containing December 31 under start-inclusive/end-exclusive matching.
fields.null_semantics: Null when December 31 falls in a regime gap.

fields.name: year_end_regime_type
fields.description: Repository-provided regime type at December 31.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

fields.name: year_end_regime_label
fields.description: Repository-provided regime label at December 31.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

fields.name: year_end_source_id
fields.description: Primary source supporting the rate in force at year end.
fields.null_semantics: Null when no year-end rate is known.

fields.name: year_end_source_url
fields.description: URL of year_end_source_id.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

fields.name: source_count
fields.description: Distinct sources used by in-year canonical rows and the year-end carry-in state.

fields.name: provenance_summary
fields.description: Sorted pipe-delimited provenance classes represented in the year.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: SnapshotV2 identifier used as the build input.

fields.name: snapshot_checksum
fields.description: SnapshotV2 content checksum used as the build input.

fields.name: snapshot_retrieved_at
fields.description: SnapshotV2 retrieval timestamp.

fields.name: dataset_schema_version
fields.description: Independent semantic schema version for this dataset.

fields.name: record_text
fields.description: Deterministically generated factual annual summary for search, RAG, and agent use.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Stable source identifier from SnapshotV2.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Publisher derived from the source URL/domain.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Source adapter/type from SnapshotV2.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Source title from SnapshotV2.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Authoritative source URL from SnapshotV2.

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: Source publication timestamp when supplied.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the source record has no publication timestamp.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: Source retrieval timestamp.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: SHA-256 checksum recorded for the source.

fields.name: is_primary_source
fields.description: Whether the source is classified as a direct primary RBI rate source.

fields.name: provenance_class
fields.description: official_primary, official_secondary, or legacy_import.

events.row_grain: one row per contextual macro/policy event

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Stable contextual event identifier from SnapshotV2.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar date of the contextual event.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Short event label.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Contextual event description from the repository snapshot.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Repository event type.

fields.name: citation_url
fields.description: Citation URL for the contextual event.

regimes.row_grain: one row per repository-provided regime interval

fields.name: regime_id
fields.description: Stable deterministic regime interval identifier.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: Inclusive start date of the contextual regime.

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: Exclusive end date of the contextual regime.

fields.name: regime_type
fields.description: Repository-provided contextual regime type.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Repository-provided contextual regime label.

relationships: decisions.primary_source_id and annual.year_end_source_id resolve to sources.source_id.
decisions.regime_id and annual.year_end_regime_id resolve to regimes.regime_id when non-null.
events are contextual and are not joined to decisions or interpreted as causal explanations.
semantic_rules: Parquet is canonical; CSV and JSONL are interoperability exports and are not additional Hugging Face configurations.
decision_date is null for imported historical observations because the source does not identify a separate policy decision date.
effective_date is the canonical ledger ordering/effective date for every decision row.
annual start rate is the latest known rate strictly before January 1; end rate is the latest known rate on or before December 31.
annual gross hikes and gross cuts use only canonical transitions within that year; a first observation is not a hike or cut.
regime intervals use start-inclusive/end-exclusive matching; gaps remain null.
unknown values are typed nulls, never empty strings or sentinel labels.

csv_conventions.timestamps: UTC ISO-8601 text ending in Z
